description: JAROWINKLER_SIMILARITY(s1, s2) - Jaro-Winkler similarity scaled to an integer 0-100 and case-insensitive: Snowflake's documented example ('Snowflake', 'Oracle') is 61, the classic MARTHA/MARHTA pair (Jaro 0.944 plus a 3-character prefix bonus) is 96, identical strings are 100, case differences do not count, and a NULL argument yields NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/JarowinklerSimilarityTest (now retired).
